① Futures — BZ=F · CL=F
ENTER FIRST. setup=none + ADX>30 + MACD=Bull. Measured: 85% base · 92% with Today+Ovn · 100% with +Month quickset. Apply ⊕Month signal quickset for highest confirmation. Only BZ=F (Brent) and CL=F (WTI) qualify. Skip PL=F (Platinum) and SI=F (Silver) — different behaviour. Not before Monday NY (week=AVOID at Asia open). Weekly futures hold (66% · ADX>40 selects BZ=F + CL=F specifically)
② FX — Currency Pairs
ENTER SECOND. Run tiers in order — stop at first hit. No signal quicksets needed (redundant for FX). Best pairs: NZDJPY (10/10) · NZDUSD (8/8) · NZDCHF (7/7) — prioritise these when they qualify. Bear pairs: AUDNZD · GBPNZD · CAD=X. RSI>35 required for bear entries. Never enter FX trend_bull (44% — harmful). Only momentum_bull. ① Best: momentum_bull · ADX 35-50 · MACD=Bull · RSI<75 (100% · ~0.5 pairs/session) ② Standard: ADX>35 any setup · MACD=Bull (97% · ~0.9 pairs/session) — use when Best = 0 ③ Fallback: ADX>25 any setup (82% · ~1.4 pairs/session) — use when Std = 0 FX Weekly (hold all week · ADX 30-40 for weekly holds)
③ ETF Bear — Sector Decline
ENTER THIRD. momentum_bear is the only reliable ETF bear setup (80% 24h). trend_bull ETF = 16% — NEVER enter. breakout_bull ETF = 63% — enter only with Today+Ovn confirmed. RS<-1.0 required. ADX ceiling at 44 same as equity — over-extended bears reverse. ETF Bear — momentum_bear · ADX 25-44 · RSI 20-55 · RS<-1.0 (80% 24h · ~2.2/session) ETF Bear Weekly (67% · ADX 35-44)
④ Equity — Individual Stocks
ENTER FOURTH. Run tiers in order. Do NOT add signal quicksets — they reduce equity success. Priority watchlist (100% whenever they qualify): NUE · HSIC · BBGI · LAUR · MOV · NHP. setup=momentum_bull → skip (48%, coin flip). setup=accumulation → skip (41%). ① Best: trend_bull · ADX 35-40 · RSI 40-60 (84% · ~0.7/session) ② Broad: trend_bull · ADX>35 (65% · ~5/session) — use when Best = 0 Equity Weekly (47% — needs daily Hold Check)
⑤ ETF Bull — Sector Breakout
ENTER LAST. breakout_bull is the only viable ETF bull setup (63% base, 71% with Today+Ovn). Apply Today+Ovn signal quickset before entering — if today AND overnight are not both positive, skip. 50% ceiling without signal confirmation. ETF bull weekly = 51% (barely viable, use only if BOW confirmed). breakout_bull · ADX>30 · RSI 50-75 — apply Today+Ovn quickset first (63%→71%) ETF Bull Weekly (51% · marginal — BOW confirmed only)

✅ Vetted Entry — start here
Runs the full checklist in one click: alignment + momentum + trend + RSI range + HIGH conf + earnings-safe FX/Futures use a different version below — their confidence model rarely reaches HIGH (see Vetted Entry FX/Futures), so the equity version above will almost never fire for them. NY session only — uses today's signal (today=AVOID for all FX at Asia/London open) Asia + London session — uses d5+week (today=AVOID for all FX/Futures at these sessions). Works for Asia overlap pairs (JPY/AUD/NZD) AND London pairs (GBP/EUR/CHF) that have d5=BUY. For London pairs where d5=AVOID too (CHF=X, EUR/USD), use 🌍 London FX Carry instead.

🔍 Early Move
🚨 Exit Signals
Review open positions when these fire. 'Momentum Reversal Warning' = today turned SELL while week/month still BUY (early crack). 'Breakdown Confirmed' = today+week turned SELL while month/m6 still BUY (stronger signal). Distribution Exit = full distribution setup with MACD Bear confirmation.
🔥 Early Breakout
Confirmed across AXTI +6331%, MUL +5060%, MUU +5165% at the earliest actionable entry point — months before RS or MA200 were available. Use as a WATCHLIST requiring further research.
🚀 Sustained Momentum
Fires after the move is underway. RS>10 means outperforming SPY by 10×+. All four timeframes (today/week/month/6mo) must agree BUY. Still left +600-4000% on the stocks analysed.
🌱 Pre-Breakout
Accumulation setup = today quiet/AVOID but medium and long-term trend intact. High RS + strong ADX distinguishes the ~4% that go on to become large movers from the rest.
📅 Multi-Day Hold (2-5d)
All four timeframes must agree. HIGH confidence + RS>1.5 + above MA200 + MA aligned. Tighter than any same-session combo — designed for 2-5 day holds.
🌏 Asia Session Carry
Designed for use during Asia or London session when FX sig-today is typically AVOID. Uses only completed timeframe signals (d5, week) + ADX + MACD. Question: does this pair have enough trend momentum to carry into the NY open? FX Futures
🌍 London Session
For use 06:00–13:30 UTC. At London open, today=AVOID for ALL FX pairs — even London pairs like EUR/USD. Two FX tiers: Carry (week+MACD agree, higher conviction) and Strong Trend (MACD+ADX only, use 50% size — no weekly confirmation). Pre-market equity filters your Watch list down to 5-10 highest-conviction names for the NY open. FX Carry — Week+MACD agree (full size) FX Strong Trend — MACD only, no week signal (50% size) Pre-market equity — NY open preparation (06:00–13:30 UTC)

⬡ Trading Guide
📡 How It Works
Each symbol is scored across 13 timeframes: Today, Overnight (OC), Overnight C↔C, 5D, Week, Past Wk, Pw C↔C, Month, Past Mo, Pm C↔C, 6Mo, YTD, 1Yr.
Each timeframe returns BUY, SELL, or AVOID.
Confidence = how many technical factors align (RSI, MACD, MA stack, ADX, structure, volume).
All filters combine with AND — every active filter must match.
🗂 Filter Panel Sections
SectionWhat it does
Signal FiltersCycle each timeframe: ALL → BUY → SELL → AVOID → ALL
Setup FilterChart pattern (Momentum, Trend, Pullback, Breakout, Mean Rev…) + Confidence
Technical ConfirmationMACD state, Trend strength, Structure, BB Signal, MA toggles, RSI/ADX/RS ranges
Confirmation CombosOne-click multi-filter stacks by trader type — day, swing, position, scalp
Asset FiltersType (Equity/ETF/FX/Futures/Crypto) + Source (exchange/index)
Sort PresetsMulti-column sort combos optimised for different strategies
PresetsGrouped by trader style: All Instruments, Day, Swing, Position, Scalp, ETF, Early Move
Quick FiltersVol >2× Avg, Vol Δ >Prev, Move >0.4×ATR, ⚡ Rejected, Hide Earnings <7d
Δ% Change FilterFilter by % move per period — grouped: Intraday / Short-Term / Month / Long-Term
Δ% Presets144 pre-built % combos across 6 tier groups (Position → Scalper)
Momentum Score0-10 composite: RS >1.5 (+2), Vol >2× (+2), ADX >25 (+2), MA aligned (+1), Above MA200 (+1), MACD Bull (+1), HIGH conf (+1)
WatchlistPaste tickers to highlight or filter to watchlist only
ColumnsShow/hide columns by preset (Minimal/Trading/Full) or individual toggle
⏱ Day Trader — Equity / ETF
Use Confirmation Combos → Day Trader for one-click setup. Focus on Today signal + volume confirmation.
SetupFiltersKey confirmation
Day MomentumHIGH conf · Today=BUY · MACD Cross↑ · ADX>20 · HH+HLVol >2× — institutional move
Day PullbackPullback ↑ · Today=BUY · 5D=SELL · RSI 35-55 · MA AlignedBuying the dip in uptrend
Day BreakoutHIGH conf · Breakout · Today+5D=BUY · MACD Cross↑ · Vol >2×ADX >25 = trend conviction
Day FadeRejected · Today=SELL · RSI >65 · BB Overbought · Vol >2×Exhausted move reversal

⚡ Early Mover — Basket Approach
What this is for: catching momentum names before their move shows up as a confirmed Today signal. What it can't do: identify in advance which name becomes a 10x — that's not knowable from any screener. Treat results as a watchlist of candidates, not a list of guaranteed winners.
FilterThresholdWhy
RS>4 (long) / <-4 (short)Top/bottom ~10% of universe — genuinely outlying strength/weakness
VOLx>2Volume surge — the earliest tell, often precedes price confirmation
ADX>20A real trend is forming, not just noise
RSI≤75 (long) / ≥25 (short)Excludes names already extended — by the time RSI is >75 the early part of the move is over
Conf / Today signalNot requiredConfirmation lags the move; requiring it filters out the earliest entries
Basket sizing, not stock-picking: this approach works as a portfolio, not a single bet. Most early-mover candidates won't pan out — a handful of small, equal-sized positions across the full list (rather than concentrating in one or two names) is how the occasional large winner offsets the more common small losses. Re-run the combo each session; candidates rotate as RS/volume conditions change.
⬡ Cross-Session Workflow & Trade Duration
The most powerful signal the screener produces is persistence across sessions. A stock that appears in Watch ↑ at Asia, Pre-Market ↑ at London, and Vetted Entry ↑ at NY has been checked by three independent snapshots hours apart and passed every time. That consistency is itself evidence of strength — and the primary edge the screener gives you.

🌍 London Session (06:00–13:30 UTC)
Markets open: All FX pairs including GBP/EUR/CHF. Futures closed. Equity = WATCH (pre-market).
StepButtonAction

🗽 NY Session (13:30–21:00 UTC)
Markets open: All equity, ETF, futures. The primary session for equity entry signals.
StepButtonAction
1. Wait 5 minutes—13:30-13:35 UTC has wide spreads. Let the open settle before entering.
2. Live equity entries⚡ Enter ↑120+ signals. Too many to act on directly — use as confirmation that market is active.
3. Apply Vetted Entry✅ Vetted Entry ↑Narrows to ~26. This is your working list. Sort by RS descending.
4. Cross-reference—Stocks in Vetted Entry ↑ that were also on your Asia Watch ↑ + London Pre-Market ↑ list = 5-tick trades.
5. Tier focusT1 ★★★ badgeT1 first (RS>20 or RS>5+ADX>35) · T2 at 0.75% risk · T3 skip unless chart is exceptional.
6. Short side⚡ Enter ↓ then ✅ Vetted Entry ↓Rarer in rising markets. Only act if stock has RS<0 and today+d5+week all SELL.
7. Monitor open positions⚠️ Momentum ReversalCheck mid-session. Any open position appearing here = tighten stop or partial exit.

The exit signal is working. Note: all 7 measured days were up days — down-market performance is unmeasured until more data accumulates.

Based on real data: FTI appeared in Vetted Entry across 9 of 11 snapshots over 5 days — the most persistent signal. RXT was BUY across all timeframes on Jul 8 but showed SELL on Jul 10 Asia and dropped -30.3% that session. The screener would have shown the flip at Asia open — anyone checking would have exited before the damage.

Set Min/Max % per period. Groups: Intraday (Today/Ovn/OvnC↔C) · Short-Term (5D/Week/PastWk) · Month (This Mo/Past Mo) · Long-Term (6Mo/YTD/1Yr).
Positive = gainers · Negative = losers · Blank = ignore · All active rows combined with AND.
Δ% Presets are organised in 6 tiers by how many timeframes must agree:
🏦 Position (10+ TF) → 📊 Swing Multi-TF (7+) → 📊 Swing+YTD → 📊 Swing+6M → ⏱ Day-Swing (5+) → ⚡ Scalper (short-term only).
Each tier has Early (0.1%), 0.2%, Standard (1%), Strong (2%) thresholds for both Buy and Sell.
⭐ Starred buttons are the validated best combinations, found by back-testing every preset's matches against live confidence/ADX/RS data:
• Buy side: 🏦 Position tier (10-13 TF) at 1% or 2% — average RS nearly doubled vs the same threshold at fewer timeframes (4.8 → 7.8-10.9), with HIGH-confidence representation also rising.
• Sell side: only the 🏦 Position tier at -2% showed the same lift (HIGH-conf 13%→19%, RS roughly doubling). Looser sell thresholds (-0.1% to -1%) showed little quality difference by threshold alone — pair them with Vetted Entry ↓ in Confirmation Combos rather than relying on % alignment by itself for shorts.
Start with 🏦 Position @ 1% Buy for a broad long watchlist, or @ 2% Buy for a tighter high-conviction list.
